questions.prompt: Which topic is explicitly listed in the syllabus coverage for “Cross-Origin Resource Sharing”?
questions.explanation: The attached FastAPI syllabus lists “Understanding browser origins” under this lesson. The remaining syllabus subtopics are preserved in the lesson file for complete coverage.

questions.prompt: According to the worked example in “Cross-Origin Resource Sharing”, which result should the learner verify?
options: Without Authorization: Bearer <token>, the request is rejected. This demo does not authenticate or authorize the token.
The app publishes itself to production and passes all tests automatically.
HTTP 500 is returned for every valid request.
Input validation and authorization are disabled by design.
questions.answer_key: Without Authorization: Bearer <token>, the request is rejected. This demo does not authenticate or authorize the token.
questions.explanation: The worked example explicitly documents this expected result. Reproduce it locally in the listed environment before treating it as tested behavior.

questions.prompt: Which CORS/middleware setup is appropriate? (Cross-Origin Resource Sharing)
options: Allow only intended origins/methods/headers and test the middleware behavior
Use wildcard origins with credentialed browser requests without reviewing policy
Log authorization headers to debug every request
questions.answer_key: Allow only intended origins/methods/headers and test the middleware behavior
questions.explanation: CORS is a browser access policy, not authentication; credentialed requests require explicit origin policy.
